head_fit.feature_standardization: Mean and standard deviation from fit partition only; exclude dimensions with fit standard deviation <= 1e-6.
head_fit.type: linear sigmoid score on standardized frozen features
head_fit.weights: Half loss per class; split positive half equally among present night, crested-other, other-positive domains; equal source-image mass within each domain; crops share image mass. Negative half unchanged.

output_interpretation: Uncalibrated lizard-presence score; not a probability of health or anomaly.

preprocessing.difference_from_official_preset: Square padding preserves the entire detected crop; no 256-resize/224-center-crop.
preprocessing.geometry: Clip padded crop to image, center-pad to square with RGB (124,116,104), bilinear resize to 224.

feature_interpretation: Frozen DINOv2 Small final normalized CLS token, 384 values.
